# PROCESS — what I did this iteration (explainability; REQUIRED)

## Ranked issue list (clusters by # failing tasks × trials, biggest first)
| rank | cluster | tasks | shared root cause | tag (KNOWLEDGE / BEHAVIORAL / CAPABILITY-GAP) | planned change class |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Over-Modification / Out-of-Bounds | 395-36, 48527, 50768, 59595 | Agent modifies cells outside the `answer_position` or changes data that should remain unchanged. | BEHAVIORAL | STRUCTURE |
| 2 | Formula Leak / Literal Value Miss | 267-18 | Agent writes formula strings (e.g., starting with `=`) or fails to compute literal values. | BEHAVIORAL | STRUCTURE |
| 3 | Empty / Missing Writes | 37456, 80-42 | Target range is left empty or significantly under-filled. | BEHAVIORAL | STRUCTURE |
| 4 | Incorrect Values / Precision | 51-12, 53647, 227-40, 43436 | Values are numerically wrong (lower than expected) or have wrong types (float instead of int). | BEHAVIORAL / KNOWLEDGE | CONTRACT |

## Changes made this iteration (one row per edit — aim for MULTIPLE classes, incl. a NEW tool when a cluster needs a new mechanism)
| cluster | edit class | file / tool | what & why it generalizes | protects passing? |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Over-Modification | STRUCTURE | prompt.md | Added a mandatory "Cross-Check" in the Verify step: compare output cells outside `answer_position` with input cells to ensure no accidental changes. | Yes, passing tasks are precise. |
| Formula Leak | STRUCTURE | prompt.md | Elevated "Literal Values Only" to a hard check in the Verify step: search for strings starting with `=` in the target range. | Yes, passing tasks already write literals. |
| Empty Writes | STRUCTURE | guidance.md | Updated the Verification Step to explicitly check for `None` values in the target range where data was expected. | Yes, passing tasks fill their ranges. |
| Incorrect Values | CONTRACT | guidance.md | Explicitly require casting to `int` for integer results and double-check precision for "lower than expected" results. | Yes, passing tasks use correct types. |

## Verify-the-fix (one line per change: the trace it targets → what the guard/computation/new-tool now edits on those exact inputs)
- 395-36, 50768, 59595: modified cells outside range → new "Cross-Check" step requires comparing output to input for all modified cells.
- 267-18: wrote formula `=CONCATENATE(...)` → new "Literal Value" check in Verify step forbids strings starting with `=`.
- 37456, 80-42: target range empty → new "Completeness" check in Verify step identifies `None` values.
- 53647: float where int expected → guidance now explicitly requires `int` casting for integer results.

## Process & features used
- Serial diagnosis of failing trajectories.
- Applied STRUCTURE (Verification checklist) and CONTRACT (Type requirements) levers.

## Good things to PRESERVE (do not let a future iteration undo these)
- The strict ban on formulas.
- The requirement for typed values.
- The mandatory verification step.
- The new strict cross-check for over-modification.

## Deliberately skipped (cluster + why — already-passing / needs gold / infra noise)
- None.
